estimator: Augmented inverse-probability weighting using logistic propensity and linear outcome regression on observed affinity and log viewing opportunity; household bootstrap for intervals.
sensitivity: Vary an explicitly simulated latent loyalty factor that affects both presentation assignment and later return; do not use latent or oracle fields in the estimator.
interpretation: Exploratory observational sensitivity demonstration only; randomized ITT remains primary and observational results cannot approve a metric or replace the target.
prohibited_changes: Do not include oracle propensity, latent loyalty, true return probability, or future return in estimator features.
Do not interpret AIPW as removing unmeasured confounding.
Do not conflate observational adjusted effects with randomized household ITT results.
